integrity: All displayed equalities and asymptotics have a self-contained analytical proof in RESULT.md and reproducible finite checks in checker.py; numerical checks are not the proof.
scientific_limitations: Common-center nonnegative Poisson mixtures; compact support strictly inside the unit disk for fixed mixtures; fixed compact positive-depth law in boundary scaling. Fourier stationarity for a two-component wrapped-Cauchy mixture was previously obtained by Bailey (2019). Independently established mathematical and priority certification not available.
title: Convex-order concentration bias and a sharp boundary-layer law for least-squares Poisson mixtures
